consent.invitation: You are invited to participate in a research study conducted as part of a doctoral dissertation entitled:
consent.title: "Towards Transparent Geospatial AI: Investigating Strategies and Techniques for Explainability and Trustworthiness in AI-Driven Geospatial Decision-Making."
consent.acknowledgement: By participating in this study, you acknowledge that:
consent.point1: Your participation is voluntary and you may withdraw at any time.
consent.point2: Your responses will be used exclusively for scientific research.
consent.point3: All collected data will be processed and published in anonymized form.
consent.point4: No personally identifiable information will be collected.
consent.point5: The content of your responses will not be altered or falsified.
consent.agree: By providing your consent, you agree to participate in this study.
consent.consent-checkmark: I consent to participate in this study.

welcome.title: Welcome and Thank You
welcome.subtitle: Thank you for participating in this study.
welcome.description1: In this session, you will explore a set of interactive maps related to wildfire susceptibility and answer questions about what you see.
welcome.description2: The study focuses on how different map designs support understanding of machine learning model explanations and uncertainty.
welcome.description3: There are no right or wrong visualization styles — we are interested in how people interpret them.
welcome.time-declaration: The session will take approximately 15–20 minutes.
